spec.description:
Bradford Fireseal Fire Damper Strip is a high-density,
non-combustible rockwool insulation material specifically formulated to provide
passive fire protection around fire dampers, service penetrations, and control
joints. Manufactured by spinning molten natural rock and recycled blast furnace
slag into bio-soluble fibres bonded with a thermosetting resin, it offers
remarkable resistance to shrinkage at extreme fire temperatures up to 820°C. It
is installed compressed in the gap between a fire damper sleeve and the
fire-rated wall or floor structure.
features:
Non-combustible stone wool
material complying with AS 1530.1

Exceptional resistance to shrinkage under
high fire temperatures

Specifically engineered for fire damper gaps and
penetration sealing
High nominal density of 110 kg/m³ (Fibertex 820 base)

Performance not adversely
affected by contact with water

Easy to cut and friction-fit into tight
structural joints

Made from natural rock and up to 40% recycled blast furnace
slag

Suitable for Fire Resistance Levels (FRL) up to -/240/240 in tested
systems

spec.sustainability:
Manufactured from up to 40% recycled blast furnace

install:
Clean opening
around fire damper sleeve, pipe penetration, or control joint

Cut Fireseal
Damper Strip to length allowing for continuous perimeter wrapping

Pack strips
tightly into the gap between damper sleeve and fire-rated substrate

Ensure
the 13mm strip is compressed by at least 15% (to 11mm or less) to form a tight
seal

Seal all butt joints neatly with approved fire-rated sealant or tape if
required by system specification

Fix damper retaining angles over the joint
as per manufacturer fire test requirements
selection_checklist:
Verify
required Fire Resistance Level (FRL) and damper certification details

Confirm
gap dimensions between damper sleeve and structural wall/floor
(typically 10-25mm)

Determine number of layers needed based on annular gap
width
Calculate total linear metres required around damper perimeters
Confirm substrate compatibility (Speedpanel, Hebel, masonry, or drywall)
limitations:
Must be compressed
by at least 15% to maintain rated fire integrity

Not designed as external
exposed weatherproofing without protective flashing

Must not be loaded
structurally; damper body must be independently supported

retrieval.rag_summary:
Bradford Fire
Protection - Damper Strip (Fireseal Fire Damper Strip / Fibertex 820 Damper
Strip) is a specialized 13mm thick, high-density (110 kg/m³) rockwool insulation
strip engineered for passive fire stopping. Specifically designed to seal the
perimeter clearance between fire dampers and fire-rated walls or floor slabs, it
also provides horizontal joint fire protection in Hebel and Speedpanel systems.
It resists shrinkage at temperatures up to 820°C, complies with AS 1530.1 as
non-combustible, and must be installed under a minimum 15% compression to
achieve rated fire resistance levels (up to -/240/240).
